shots.subject: Demian waking up amidst empty bottles
shots.continuity_notes: Establishes alcohol evidence and severe hangover symptoms.
shots.performance: Demian is cynical, extremely irritable, nauseated, dehydrated, noise-sensitive, and painfully light-sensitive. His physical movements, however, reveal perfectly nominal motor control and reflexes.
shots.blocking: An aggressively loud, bright holographic 'CONSTRUCTOR FORCE VR' commercial blares, tearing Demian out of an alcohol-heavy cat-nap. Empty beer cans and liquor bottles surround him. The Announcer yells about 'Foundation Frenzy' and 'RealPain Haptic Feedback', the Foreman barks orders about '10-14 construction units' and 'VirtualCrew Dynamics', and the Legal Voice speed-reads the 'OSHA/Union DLC' joke. Demian wakes up wincing, shielding his eyes.
